title: FAFSA contributors and consent
facts: A FAFSA contributor can include the student, student's spouse, biological or adoptive parent, or parent's spouse depending on the student's circumstances.
Being identified as a contributor does not make that person financially responsible for the student's education costs.
Required contributors generally need their own StudentAid.gov account to complete their section and provide required approval and consent for federal tax information processes.
Who counts as a parent for FAFSA purposes follows federal student-aid rules and is not always the same as who claims the student on a tax return.
